## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `--exclude` flag still needs to read its default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`. Project policy requires this for every new flag under `cli/`, because CI sets options through the environment.

## Changes
This pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option to the archive CLI. `collect` now skips files whose basename matches any pattern and logs each skip. The pull request also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md`, adds unit and end-to-end tests, and adds a text fixture under `tests/fixtures/`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default --exclude from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — If CI sets `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log`, it has no effect, because `--exclude` uses the fixed `default=[]` and nothing reads the environment. This breaks `.claude/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI jobs that set options through the environment cannot exclude files, so their archives silently include everything. — Fix: Seed the default from `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE")`, choose a separator for multiple patterns, and extend `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing` with an environment-set case.
